name: tinwright
description: Plugins, skills and mods for Claude Code, from the tinwright workshops.

plugins.name: example
plugins.description: A starting point: a mod with one slash command (/example) that says hello.

plugins.name: current-affairs
plugins.description: Panes of your recent Claude Code sessions across all projects: grouped by repo and GitHub issue or branch with what each piece of work cost (/work), with this session's context and usage limits, and last week's activity and hours worked, with trends (/timeline).

plugins.name: clawd-buddy
plugins.description: A little pixel Clawd above your prompt who reacts to what Claude is doing: thinks, types, waves for approval, sips coffee in the morning and sleeps at night.

plugins.name: skywatch
plugins.description: A sky behind the chat that follows the sun where you are, with a small sun or a moon in its real phase. It draws only the sky and leaves the space above the prompt free, so it sits alongside Clawd Buddy or any other mod there.

plugins.name: pixel-buddy
plugins.description: A pixel buddy above your prompt that Claude designs from your description or a picture, then animates as it thinks, types, waves for approval and sleeps at night.

plugins.name: vim-look
plugins.description: A Vim look for Claude Code: dark terminal grays, monospace everywhere, tildes down the gutter, a live NORMAL, INSERT and COMMAND status line above the prompt, and :w, :q and :wq that answer the way Vim would.

plugins.name: anaglyph-look
plugins.description: A dark theme with a 3D scene behind the chat for red-cyan glasses: an arena of tanks and beacons that follows what Claude is doing, or a grid with floating shapes, and a calibration step that tunes the colors to your glasses.
